# Postman / Integration Testing Agent

@project/input_postman/

@agents/postman/rules/intent-gen-postman.mdc
@agents/postman/rules/gen-postman-implementation.mdc

---

**Input folder scanned:** `project/input_postman/`

If files were found above, the agent will use them automatically.

**Additional context (optional):** `project/input_develop/` — if `jira-*.md` and `confluence-design.md` are present (generated by `/use-develop`), the agent will use them for richer request body examples and scenario descriptions.

**Fallback — if the folder was empty, provide one of:**
- RAML or OpenAPI spec (`.raml`, `.yaml`) for the target API
- MUnit test suite XML files for fixture-based request/response extraction
- Describe the API name and the agent will locate the spec via its lookup chain (pom.xml → Exchange → local cache → workspace)

**Output will be written to:** `agents/postman/examples/{api-name}.postman_collection.json`

> One agent per chat. Start a new chat with `/use-postman` for each new collection task.
> Never hardcode `client_id`, `client_secret`, or tokens — always use Postman collection variables.
